chapter.v:
Sing a
new song to the Lord! Let the whole earth sing to the Lord!

Sing to
the Lord; praise his name.Each day proclaim the good news that he saves.

Publish his
glorious deeds among the nations.Tell everyone about the amazing things he does.

Great is
the Lord! He is most worthy of praise! He is to be feared above all gods.

The gods
of other nations are mere idols,but the Lord made the heavens!

Honor and
majesty surround him;strength and beauty fill his sanctuary.

O nations
of the world, recognize the Lord;recognize that the Lord is glorious and strong.

Give to
the Lord the glory he deserves! Bring your offering and come into his courts.

Worship the
Lord in all his holy splendor.Let all the earth tremble before him.

Tell all
the nations, “The Lord reigns!”The world stands firm and cannot be shaken.He will judge all peoples fairly.

Let the
heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice! Let the sea and everything in it shout his praise!

Let the
fields and their crops burst out with joy! Let the trees of the forest sing for joy

before the
Lord, for he is coming! He is coming to judge the earth.He will judge the world with justice,and the nations with his truth.
